A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Codex" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Alde" /> '''member''' of [[House Alde]], a [[Great Houses of Alderaan|noble house]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], held the title of [[Earl/Legends|earl]] sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Considered to be undistinguished by other nobles, the earl was arranged to be [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Gesselle Organa|Gesselle]] of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] on Gesselle's eighteenth birthday, but the wedding was postponed and ultimately cancelled for reasons unknown to the general public.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Alde earl was mentioned in Gesselle Organa's Codex entry in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
